findings.element: Stock check tab empty table 'No unresolved differences.' and Overview Stock check line 'Stock is the same in QuickBooks and Shopify.' (State 3)
findings.finding: When one store's nightly comparison failed, both the differences page and the Overview block show an unqualified all-clear, and on the differences page the failure appears only as text in the 'Latest comparison' meta line.
findings.user_impact: Users scanning the empty table conclude stock matches in every store and never re-run the comparison for My good flowers, so its existing differences stay open.
findings.suggested_fix: Scope the all-clear to the stores that were actually compared (e.g. 'My ceramic plates: no differences') and show the failed store as an error row with Compare now inside the table area on the Stock check tab.

evidence.action: Opened V2 State 3 Overview, then the Stock check tab.
evidence.observed: Overview: 'The last check of My good flowers failed (Oct 2, 2026 02:30), so its stock wasn't compared. Compare now' followed by 'Stock is the same in QuickBooks and Shopify.'; Stock check tab: 'Latest comparison · My ceramic plates: Oct 2, 2026 02:30 · My good flowers: failed Oct 2, 2026 02:30' then a table reading only 'No unresolved differences.'

findings.element: 2-step onboarding (first store) vs 'Setup needed' steps on the My good flowers store card
findings.finding: Getting a store ready works differently for the first store and later stores: onboarding is 1 Enable inventory tracking → 2 Choose location, while the store card lists 1 Choose location → 2 Set Created product to Inventory → 3 1 item needs mapping, with different step names and an extra mapping step.
findings.user_impact: Users who learned the 2-step flow on the first store meet a reordered, renamed 3-step list for the next store and cannot tell whether mapping is now required before the store is ready.
findings.suggested_fix: Use the same step order and labels for the setup steps in onboarding and on the store card, and keep 'needs mapping' visually separate from the numbered setup steps.

evidence.action: Completed onboarding for My ceramic plates in V2 State 1, then opened V2 State 2 Overview with My good flowers in Setup needed.
evidence.observed: Onboarding: '1 Enable inventory tracking … 2 Choose location', 'Step 1 of 2'; store card: '1 Choose location … 2 Set Created product to Inventory … 3 1 item needs mapping … Map products'.

findings.element: Empty state 'Connect store' button vs onboarding 'Finish setup' button
findings.finding: The same 'pick a value first' rule is enforced two ways in the same flow: Connect store is enabled and fails with a toast when no store is chosen, while Finish setup is disabled with a tooltip until a location is chosen.
findings.user_impact: Users click Connect store, get a transient error toast for a button that looked ready, and then cannot predict whether the next button will act or block.
findings.suggested_fix: Handle both the same way: either disable Connect store until a store is selected (with the same tooltip pattern as Finish setup) or make both buttons enabled with the same inline validation.

evidence.action: In the V2 empty state clicked Connect store with the select on 'Select…'; then in onboarding step 2 hovered Finish setup before choosing a location.
evidence.observed: Connect store → toast 'Choose a store first.'; Finish setup disabled with tooltip 'Choose a location first.'

findings.element: Stock check tab table after bulk 'Update Shopify qty' with 'Unresolved only' turned off
findings.finding: After the bulk update the resolved rows disappear and the table says 'No unresolved differences.' even though the Unresolved only filter had been turned off, so the filter has no visible effect on resolved rows.
findings.user_impact: Users cannot see on the page which products were just updated (or later, which were ignored), and the toggle reads as broken because switching it off does not bring them back.
findings.suggested_fix: With Unresolved only off, keep resolved rows in the table with their new status (e.g. Updated / Ignored), and use an empty message that matches the active filter.

evidence.action: On the Stock check differences page turned Unresolved only off, Select all, Update Shopify qty, confirmed the dialog.
evidence.observed: Before: two rows with status 'Unresolved'; after: toast '2 Shopify quantities will be updated.' and table 'Store Product SKU QuickBooks item QuickBooks Shopify Difference Status Actions / No unresolved differences.'

gaps: Compare now (Stock check tab and Overview failed-check row): never clicked, so whether it re-runs only the failed store or all stores, and what loading/result state follows, is unknown.
Ignore (row and bulk) and single-row Update Shopify qty were never exercised, so their confirmation and resulting row status are unknown.
Bulk Update Shopify qty across two stores was not exercised; the recorded dialog only covers a single-store selection.
'Use a different store' returns to the empty state, but whether the first store stays connected (and how that is shown) is not recorded.
Enable click from the post-onboarding Overview was not recorded as a commit path; only the resulting 'enabled with one store' state is captured.
Run now only toasts in the prototype, so its in-progress and result states cannot be judged.
